comparisons.reason: Different row functions. Item 0 is an ANY predicate: 1 if at least one comment uses abstract reasoning, and anecdotes in the same comment are allowed. Empty list gives 0. Item 92 is an ALL predicate: 1 only if every comment argues solely through abstract logic and none brings in a concrete external example. Empty list gives null. The quantifier, the exclusivity requirement, and the empty-list handling all differ.
